cases.sentence: Воистину Бог благ к Израилю, к чистым ___.
cases.translation: Surely God is good to Israel, to those with pure hearts.
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the dative case, and 'сердцам' is the dative plural.

cases.sentence: Мои ноги едва не поскользнулись, и стопы мои чуть не потеряли ___.
cases.translation: My feet almost slipped; my steps nearly lost their footing.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'потеряли' (lost) takes the accusative case.
The verb 'завидовать' (to envy) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Открывают уста свои против ___, и слова их расхаживают по земле.
cases.translation: They open their mouths against the heavens, and their words walk about on the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition 'против' (against) governs the genitive case, but here the accusative is used for the neuter noun.

cases.sentence: Когда я пытался все это понять, то мне это казалось слишком ___.
cases.translation: When I tried to understand this, it seemed too difficult to me.
cases.explain: The predicate adjective after 'казалось' (seemed) takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пока я не вошел в святилище Бога и не понял ___.
cases.translation: Until I entered God's sanctuary and understood the end of the wicked.
cases.explain: The verb 'понял' (understood) takes the accusative, but here the genitive 'конца' means 'their ultimate fate.'

cases.sentence: Кто есть у меня на ___, кроме Тебя?
cases.translation: Who do I have in heaven besides You?
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ослабевает моя плоть и мое ___, но Бог твердыня сердца моего.
cases.translation: My flesh and my heart fail, but God is the strength of my heart.
cases.explain: As the subject of the verb 'ослабевает' (fails), the nominative case is used.

reading.ru: Воистину Бог благ к Израилю, к чистым сердцам.
reading.question: To whom is God good according to this verse?
options: To Israel and to those with pure hearts
reading.correct: To Israel and to those with pure hearts
reading.explain: The verse states 'Бог благ к Израилю, к чистым сердцам' - God is good to Israel and to those with pure hearts.

reading.ru: Мои ноги едва не поскользнулись, стопы мои чуть не потеряли опору.
reading.question: What happened to the speaker's feet?
options: They almost slipped and nearly lost their footing
They led him to a safe place
reading.correct: They almost slipped and nearly lost their footing
reading.explain: The verse says 'ноги едва не поскользнулись' (feet almost slipped) and 'стопы чуть не потеряли опору' (steps nearly lost footing).

reading.ru: Я позавидовал надменным, увидев процветание нечестивых.
reading.question: Why did the speaker feel envious?
options: Because he saw the arrogant and the prosperity of the wicked
Because he was poor and hungry
reading.correct: Because he saw the arrogant and the prosperity of the wicked
reading.explain: The verse says 'я позавидовал надменным, увидев процветание нечестивых' - I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

reading.ru: Когда я пытался все это понять, то мне это казалось слишком трудным.
reading.question: What was the speaker's reaction when he tried to understand the prosperity of the wicked?
options: It seemed too difficult to him
He found it easy and comforting
reading.correct: It seemed too difficult to him
reading.explain: The verse states 'мне это казалось слишком трудным' - it seemed too difficult to me.

reading.ru: Пока я не вошел в святилище Бога и не понял конца их.
reading.question: What changed the speaker's understanding?
options: Entering God's sanctuary and understanding the fate of the wicked
reading.correct: Entering God's sanctuary and understanding the fate of the wicked
reading.explain: The verse says 'пока я не вошел в святилище Бога и не понял конца их' - until I entered God's sanctuary and understood their fate.

reading.ru: Кто есть у меня на небесах, кроме Тебя? И на земле я ничего, кроме Тебя, не желаю.
reading.question: What does the speaker declare about his desires?
options: He wants only God in heaven and on earth
He desires wealth and power above all
He wants many friends and companions
reading.correct: He wants only God in heaven and on earth
reading.explain: The verse states 'кто есть у меня на небесах, кроме Тебя? ... на земле я ничего, кроме Тебя, не желаю' - Who do I have in heaven but You? And on earth I desire nothing but You.
